en: I washed my clothes at home.
I didn't wash my hair yesterday.
You (m.) washed your hands before eating.
You (m.) didn't wash my shirt.
You (f.) washed your face early.
You (f.) didn't wash the dinner dishes.
My neighbor washed the car in the afternoon.

lat: khuya ma ghselsh l-kisan f l-lil
en: My brother didn't wash the glasses at night.
My mom washed the carpet at home.
My sister didn't wash her jellaba.
We washed the whole house on Saturday.
We didn't wash our blanket.
You (pl.) washed the fruit before eating it.
You (pl.) didn't wash your hands before breakfast.
The kids bathed in the bathroom early.
They didn't wash their clothes.

lat: kanghsel wejhi kul sba7 qbel l-khedma
ar: كنغسل وجهي كل صباح قبل الخدمة
en: I wash my face every morning before work.
I don't wash the dishes at night.
You (m.) wash your clothes in the washing machine.
You (m.) don't wash the glasses well.
You (f.) wash the vegetables before you cook them.

lat: ma katgheslish sh-sha3r dyalek kul nhar
ar: ما كتغسليش الشعر ديالك كل نهار
en: You (f.) don't wash your hair every day.

lat: khuya kayghsel yeddih qbel kul makla
ar: خويا كيغسل يديه قبل كل ماكلة
en: My brother washes his hands before every meal.

lat: huwa ma kayghselsh l-7wayej dyalu bu7du
ar: هو ما كيغسلش الحوايج ديالو بوحدو
en: He doesn't wash his clothes by himself.

lat: mmi katghsel d-dar kul nhar j-jem3a
ar: مي كتغسل الدار كل نهار الجمعة
en: My mom washes the house every Friday.
My aunt doesn't wash the clothes by herself.
We wash the car every Saturday.

lat: ma kangheslush f d-dar 7it l-ma mqtu3
ar: ما كنغسلوش فالدار حيت الما مقطوع
en: We don't wash at home because the water is cut off.
You (pl.) wash your room every week.
You (pl.) don't wash the glasses with soap.
They wash their clothes in the river.
They don't bathe much in winter.

lat: ghadi nghsel t-tumubil mn ba3d l-ghda
ar: غادي نغسل الطوموبيل من بعد الغدا
en: I'm going to wash the car after lunch.
I'm not going to wash your clothes.

lat: ghadi tghsel wejhek b l-ma bared
en: You (m.) are going to wash your face with cold water.
You (m.) aren't going to wash the car today.

lat: ghadi tghesli l-ghta m3a khtek ghedda
ar: غادي تغسلي الغطا مع ختك غدا
en: You (f.) are going to wash the blanket with your sister tomorrow.
You (f.) won't wash the dishes by yourself.

lat: khuya ghadi yghsel l-ard dyal d-dar
ar: خويا غادي يغسل الارض ديال الدار
en: My brother is going to wash the floor of the house.

lat: bba ma ghadish yghsel l-mwa3en l-lila
ar: بابا ما غاديش يغسل المواعن الليلة
en: Dad isn't going to wash the dishes tonight.

lat: bnti ghadi tghsel l-fakya m3a mmha
ar: بنتي غادي تغسل الفاكية مع مها
en: My daughter is going to wash the fruit with her mom.

lat: khti ma ghadish tghsel l-kisan l-yum
ar: ختي ما غاديش تغسل الكيسان اليوم
en: My sister isn't going to wash the glasses today.
We're going to wash the roof tomorrow.
We aren't going to wash the glasses tonight.

lat: ghadi tgheslu l-mwa3en qbel ma tmshiw
ar: غادي تغسلو المواعن قبل ما تمشيو
en: You (pl.) are going to wash the dishes before you leave.

lat: ma ghadish tgheslu l-7wayej dyalkum l-yum
ar: ما غاديش تغسلو الحوايج ديالكم اليوم
en: You (pl.) aren't going to wash your clothes today.

lat: l-wlad ghadi ygheslu t-tumubil m3a bbahum
ar: الولاد غادي يغسلو الطوموبيل مع بباهم
en: The kids are going to wash the car with their dad.

lat: ma ghadish ygheslu l-7wayej dyalhum bu7dhum
ar: ما غاديش يغسلو الحوايج ديالهم بوحدهم
en: They aren't going to wash their clothes by themselves.
